items.a: **Seasonal** (twice a year) → **fast fashion** (drops every few weeks) → **ultra-fast** (Shein from 2020): **~10,000 styles online every day**. Host-reported Shein sales **$1.4B (2018) → $41B (2025)**.

items.q: What is fashion as a tech proposition?
items.a: No stores, no retail staff, no designers. **Scrape** ('stealing'), **AI blender**, tiny Shanghai-area test runs, scale the hits. Press: **no soul, no craft, no human connection**.

items.q: What is the Shein app doing to you?
items.a: Prize wheels, countdown timers, 60–90% off. D'Avella had **no plan to buy** and his heart still raced. The need-question never gets a second.

items.q: What prices has a generation been programmed to accept?
items.a: **$10 tee / $50 pants / $100 jacket**, then throw them out. Apparel prices **flat 1994–2024**. Australians: **56 new items a year**.

items.q: Why can't a t-shirt honestly cost $3?
items.a: Grow, gin, spin, weave, dye, cut, sew. The squeeze is the **garment worker**: ~**75-hour weeks**, piece rates. Press wants the guilt: most people are not buying 5× more because of school uniforms.

items.q: What is the one move after watching?
items.a: **Buy much less.** Reject the system. Press would rather **walk and look at birds** than buy feathers to dress like one. Slow-fashion foil: Jarrad Cuff's **$3,800** window-workshop suit.
